purpose: Auxiliary judge/evaluator provider preferences. Model versions resolve from explicit, reviewed registry decisions.

capacity_backup.why: Owner decision 2026-10-30: slot 3 is the verifier's capacity backup, filled from Cursor, Vibe, Muse or Gemini. Used only in standard compare mode, only when one production judge returns a budget-exhaustion error, and PASS still needs the surviving production judge's PASS. Corpus trial run 41111958779 (18 recorded cases, independent labels, no adjudication): paired with gpt-6.1-sol every usable candidate matched the production pair (1 of 7 known defects passed, 11 of 11 good cases passed); muse-spark-1.3 passed the fewest known defects alone (3 of 7; Cursor and Gemini 3.8 Flash 4, Gemini 4 Argon 5) with 18 of 18 usable answers. Set enabled to false to turn the backup off.
